ranking_scope: not pooled with the main traffic-domain rankings

dataset.name: Hungarian Chickenpox Cases
dataset.value_scale: county-wise standardized FX signal units in the upstream JSON; not raw weekly case counts

source_fx_standardization.axis: each county column over all 521 source weeks

preprocessing.optimization_transform: additional single scalar mean and standard deviation estimated from training targets only
preprocessing.evaluation_inverse_transform: reverses only the additional training-target scalar transform
preprocessing.reported_error_units: upstream county-wise standardized FX signal units
preprocessing.time_features: week index modulo 52 plus one zero dummy channel

graph.construction: source neighbor edges symmetrized with self-loops

model_specific_supports.other_models: their released adaptive, memory, normalization, identity, or embedding paths

optimization.checkpoint_storage: best state retained in memory; no checkpoint files written by this script

model_dimensions.D2STGNN: hidden=16, node_hidden=8, time_embedding=8, layers=5, k_t=3, k_s=2
model_dimensions.MTGNN: gcn_depth=2, node_dim=16, conv/residual=16, skip=32, end=64, layers=2
model_dimensions.STAEformer: input/time embeddings=8, adaptive embedding=16, feed-forward=64, heads=4, layer=1

interval_diagnostic.interval: point prediction plus or minus the model-and-seed validation residual quantile
interval_diagnostic.temporal_dependence_caveat: reported coverage is an empirical diagnostic, not an exchangeability guarantee
